rationale: Adds persisted brief archetype and kit allow-list fields and rewrites the art-director, image and design prompts that every Path B post depends on, across roughly 20-30 files including schema, renderer sampling and the brief wizard, even though the default stays classic-background.

signals.blast_radius: About 20-30 files across prompt builders, background.ts, the ImageProvider/OpenAI impl, renderer sampling, brand-kit admin UI, brief wizard, schema and tests; the new archetype layer changes design prompts for every Path B generation once enabled
signals.unresolved: Open questions are mostly Phase 2/3 or tuning (transparent output, quality cost, Haiku vs Sonnet for art direction, regenerate-once); the safe-area fallback is already decided, so no open question alters the Phase 1 file list
signals.irreversibility: Code is revertible, but the new brief archetype and kit allow-list columns are persisted data shape that stays after a revert, and enabling archetypes changes the look of posts already in the library
